title: "Pen Tool Options Widget"
format: html
---

## Overview

`PenToolOptions_Widget` is the options-bar page shown when `MediaToolId::Pen` is active in the Media Viewer left tool strip. It provides Pen tool usage instructions, pen target selection, and append-endpoint policy.

## Controls

| Control | State field | Description |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| Pen target combo | `LineInteractionPrefs::pen_target_mode`, `pen_new_line_key` | **Selected line** edits the current selection; **New line · {key}** creates a new `LineData` entity on click |
| Append to combo | `LineInteractionPrefs::append_endpoint` | Choose tip, base, or nearest endpoint for appends |

The pen target combo is rebuilt from `MediaWidgetState::enabledFeatures("line")`, mirroring `SelectToolOptions_Widget`.

## Interaction

- **Ctrl+click** appends to the selected line.
- **Click** (new-line target) creates the first vertex of a new line.
- After a new line is created, `MediaLine_Widget` auto-selects the entity and switches the pen target back to **Selected line**.
- **Alt+click** deletes the nearest vertex on the selected line at the current frame.
- **Right-click** the selected line for additional operations.

## Related Code

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| `MediaLine_Widget::_handlePenToolClick` | Dispatches create vs append |
| `MediaLine_Widget::_createNewLineAtCurrentTime` | Immediate `addAtTime` + auto-select |
| `LineDrawOperations::commitNewLineAtTime` | Qt-free commit helper returning `EntityId` |
| `LineDrawOperations::entityExistsAtTime` | Frame guard before append/delete |

See also [Media Viewer Tool Strip](MediaToolStrip.qmd) and [Line Draw Operations](LineDrawOperations.qmd).
